Reservation Staff searches bookings by guest name, phone, email, booking reference, or hotel.
Complete booking details with guest info, stay dates, and pricing breakdown. (Manual calling only, no click-to-call).
Refund Staff views pending cancellation refunds with eligibility details.
Inspects refund amount, payment transaction reference, and bank/UPI details.
Executes live Razorpay gateway refund. Requires PROCESS_REFUND permission.
Audit history of processed and settled refunds.
Payout Staff queries host payout requests.
Inspects payout earnings, platform commission, and 7-day maturity status.
Disburses host payout. Strictly validates 7-day holding period before executing.
Historical record of settled partner disbursements.

Adds internal coordination note. Strictly hidden from customer view.
Hotel Verification Staff lists newly submitted hotel listings.
Inspects hotel metadata, owner identity, and government business documents.

Rejects hotel with mandatory reason. Updates status and notifies owner.
